name: Address Static Map
description: Provides Google Static Map based on entity address fields.
project_description: Address Static Map adds a single field formatter, 'Address Static Map' (plugin id address_static_map), for the contrib Address field. When set on an address field's Manage display, it renders each address value as a Google Static Maps image (an pointing at maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/staticmap) centred on that address with a marker. It is the Drupal 8+ successor to the older addressfield_staticmap module and works only with the modern Address field. A site-wide settings form at /admin/config/system/address_static_map holds the Google API credentials: either a standard API key plus a URL-signing secret, or Google Maps Premier client ID plus crypto key. The signing secret and premium crypto key are stored as Key module entities (the module depends on Key) and used to HMAC-SHA1 sign each generated map URL. Per-display formatter settings control zoom level, image size, map style (roadmap/satellite/terrain/hybrid), retina scale, an optional custom marker icon URL and free-form extra Static Maps URL parameters. The map image is fetched by the visitor's browser, not by the Drupal server.
